name: title
description: The title by which the dataset is commonly known. Best practice is to include the data subject, date range and geographic extent.
example: Peat Depths for New Forest September 2020

name: organizationName
description: Name of organisation or group

name: abstract
description: General description of the dataset. This should summarise the overall project for which this data was collected, and include a mention of the general habitat. See also additionalInfo, purpose and methods.
example: Peat depths from survey carried out on New Forest by Defra in September 2020.

name: additionalInfo
description: Details on where additional information about the data can be found. For example, this could refer to a supplementary report by your organisation.
example: Survey data included in Assessing Carbon Stocks within New Forest Peat www.example.com/newforest-peat.pdf

name: license
description: The licence that should be applied to all records in the dataset. Should there be particular sensitivities in the dataset that prevent its publication using one of the named licenses, then an "Other" licence would be appropriate with the specific usage restrictions detailed there.

name: rights
description: Additional information about copyright or usage rights, in particular for "Other" licences.

name: bibliographicCitation
description: The text that should be used when the dataset is cited in publications and reports, to acknowledge its use.

name: geographicDescription
description: Description of the geographic extent of the dataset. For survey-based data this may be a larger geographic area than the occurrence of records within the dataset, e.g. designated site name, county.

name: westBoundingCoordinate
description: Westernmost coordinate of data coverage

name: eastBoundingCoordinate
description: Easternmost coordinate of data coverage

name: northBoundingCoordinate
description: Northernmost bounding coordinate of data coverage

name: southBoundingCoordinate
description: Southernmost coordinate of data coverage

name: temporalCoverageStartDate
description: Earliest record date

name: temporalCoverageEndDate
description: Latest record date

name: purpose
description: The purpose for which the records were originally collected and also, where different, the reason for producing the dataset.
example: Carbon monitoring across the New Forest OR Tree planting investigative survey

name: methods
description: A concise description of the methods and techniques used in the creation of the dataset, including those used in data capture plus verification and validation. Highlight any areas of uncertainty with regard to any aspect of data capture and collation.
example: Covered in detail in accompanying report.

name: qualityControl
description: An assessment of the quality of data capture and/or the collated dataset as a whole. Ascribe your general level of confidence in the data source, processing, validation, and record collation.

name: contactGivenName
description: Dataset contact's first name

name: contactSurname
description: Dataset contact's surname

name: contactElectronicMailAddress
description: Dataset contact's email

name: contactPhone
description: Dataset contact's phone number
